interpretation: White feels stark and headline oversized; try warm stone and calmer scale.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Refine the attached 8x social desktop hero concept into a warmer, more sophisticated minimal website. Output ONE full desktop hero screenshot, landscape, no device mockup or annotation. The reference is the existing design to refine: retain its original 8x social serif logo, navigation wording, exact business copy, two calls to action and five-person monochrome panorama with the same people and order. Keep the clear coherent website, not a new visual gimmick.
Primary changes: eliminate the harsh white expanse. Use a beautiful solid pale warm stone / oatmeal background #E9E5DC across the whole page, never pure white, not yellow, not peach-orange. Ink is warm near-black #242321. Main headline is around 18 percent smaller and one weight lighter than reference: polished medium-weight modern grotesk, still confident and generously scaled but no longer crushingly huge. Carefully balanced proportions, ample but deliberate spacing, desktop 1536x1050 composition.
Layout: slim header inset 68px, authentic serif 8x mark with sans social on left; For brands, For creators, How it works, Sign in, outlined Let's talk arrow. A fine warm-grey separator below header. Main text at x68 y150, EXACT two lines 'Creator networks.' and 'Built for your brand.' Last punctuation is vermilion orange #F44725. Headline should occupy roughly 70-78 percent width rather than fill edge to edge, with breathing room to its right, but don't add a decoration there. Beneath headline, supporting copy left: 'We find the creators, manage the content,' / 'and grow your organic reach.' To right of this supporting row, orange pill 'Build your network ↗' and understated text link 'See how it works →'. Buttons normal size and comfortable alignment. No eyebrow labels, badges, tiny explanatory slogans or fake statistics.
At lower half, use the same gorgeous single monochrome five-person portrait panorama on deep charcoal ground. All five heads and hair must remain wholly within the photograph; bodies may meet the bottom. No individual cards, no coloured portraits. Narrow consistent side margins aligned with the content. The photograph and warm stone surface have a natural, print-editorial contrast. Replace the reference's ragged halftone edge with a much cleaner, very fine equal-dot raster edge, only a sparse 12px wide fine fade at left and right. Faces are sharp natural photography, not halftone faces. Black area not enlarged; image should take about 40 percent viewport height. A 35px margin below it shows the same warm stone page continuing with one quiet thin rule. No orange section underneath, no extra headline. No gradients, fake paper crumples, visible noise, heavy texture, shadows, bevels, blobs, 3D, glass, duplicate 8x logo or new colours.
Target feeling: a beautifully typeset premium editorial website, warmer and more tactile in palette than stark white, calmer in typography, yet ambitious and unmistakably modern. It must be entirely plausible to implement with normal HTML, solid CSS colours and the existing static photo. Preserve readable exact copy.
